description: Hand-written ruler for the benchmark cases (SPEC_QB_RIGHELLO.md): the entities a question names, with their official home (domains or URL prefixes), and the expected contents of a complete answer, as aspects, not values. Read only by scripts/eval.py and scripts/judge.py: the engine never reads it.
